editionLabel: Ravensburger Italian Universal Monsters rules, copyright 2021, IT01; English summary
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate garlic starts. Continue clockwise after each player's turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: A turn consists of the Hero phase followed by the Monster phase.
Solo play uses one Hero, starts the Terror Level at 3, and excludes the Courier Hero.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the cited Italian Universal Monsters rulebook.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://product-files.ravensburger.cloud/manuals/663852.pdf. Finding: Whoever most recently ate garlic starts. Continue clockwise after each player's turn. Local source SHA-256: 631cb398f981b1737a2f18e271568287500fa4aaf6270c85f8840fe09c799d74. The rendered cover, starting instruction, solo section and credits were inspected. This is the original Universal Monsters game, not American Monsters. The Italian source PDF was found directly on the publisher's file host; no claim is made that the UK product page links this file. The credits state copyright 2021 and IT01. A 2023 production timestamp is not treated as the copyright year.
